clue.text: Total is a couple of graduates, Capital!

parts.note: to total is to add up
taken as written
a BA is a Bachelor of Arts graduate, and a couple gives two of them
the second BA of the pair

explanation.surface: An excited exclamation that a sum comes to two graduates, with a cheer of 'Capital!'
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital!' reads as an old-fashioned cry of approval, but it is the definition: a capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: Addis Ababa is the capital city of Ethiopia.

clue.text: Perhaps 6 mountains

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the letters of the answer to 6 might be arranged some other way

parts.note: the answer to 6 across, a word meaning hit

explanation.surface: A cross-reference hinting that something from another clue could be mountains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perhaps' signals an anagram of SLAP, the answer to 6 across.
explanation.definitionFit: The Alps are the great European mountain range.

clue.text: Difficult choice for a lot badly maimed

indicators.note: badly suggests the letters are knocked out of shape and rearranged

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty, a lot
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone faces a hard decision on behalf of a group who have been badly injured.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' signals an anagram of L (fifty in Roman numerals, 'a lot') with MAIMED.
explanation.definitionFit: A dilemma is a situation demanding a choice between two unwelcome options.

clue.text: Confess to knocking over a jar of coffee

definitions.text: knocking over a jar of coffee

explanation.surface: Someone owning up after spilling the coffee.
explanation.definitionFit: To reveal a secret is the idiomatic sense; literally, upsetting a jar of coffee beans sends them everywhere.

clue.text: Travel in reverse on three feet around the area

parts.note: to back is to move in reverse
a yard is three feet

explanation.surface: A measurement exercise: walking backwards, three feet at a time, around a plot.
explanation.definitionFit: A backyard is the area of ground behind a house.

clue.text: Exclude the lady, and her instrument

parts.note: to ban is to exclude
Jo is a girl's name, standing for the lady

explanation.surface: A demand to bar a woman along with the musical instrument she plays.
explanation.definitionFit: A banjo is a stringed musical instrument, here belonging to the lady.

clue.text: Hit friends who come back

indicators.note: coming back means the word for friends is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: pals are friends

explanation.surface: Striking out at friends who return.
explanation.definitionFit: A slap is a blow with the open hand.

clue.text: Athletic perhaps, but has no aspiration, though in a regular pattern

indicators.note: perhaps hints that the remaining letters can be arranged differently
an aspirate is the H sound, so having no aspiration means losing the letter H

explanation.surface: A sporty person may lack ambition yet still follow a steady routine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has no aspiration' removes H from ATHLETIC, leaving ATLETIC, which 'perhaps' rearranges. 'Aspiration' looks like ambition but means the breathy H sound.
explanation.definitionFit: A lattice is a criss-cross framework forming a regular repeating design.

clue.text: 27 might be used to get rid of these

definitions.text: 27 might be used to get rid of these

parts.words: 27 might be used to get rid of these
parts.note: the answer to 27, an editor's marking tool, is used to cut whole blocks of prose out of a text

explanation.surface: A cross-reference: what the editing tool in 27 deletes.
explanation.definitionFit: Editors strike out unwanted sections of text, often whole passages of writing, with a blue pencil.

clue.text: Mushroom shaped heap I made

definitions.note: the caps of mushrooms, the shaped tops, rather than an adjective

parts.note: a pile is a heap
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone describes a mushroom-shaped heap they have built.
explanation.walkthrough: PILEI is the plural of pileus, the botanical name for a mushroom's umbrella-shaped cap.
explanation.definitionFit: Pilei are the domed caps on top of mushrooms and toadstools.

clue.text: Leader who supplies current

explanation.surface: Describing someone in charge who provides electricity.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is the person who directs an orchestra; the other is a material that carries electric flow.

clue.text: Descriptive of a harrassed housewife who might cook this way

explanation.surface: A stressed homemaker and her preferred cooking method.
explanation.definitionFit: Being stressed is one sense; a pressure cooker cooks food in steam at high pressure.

clue.text: Pampering by arranging for the girl to take on only light cooking

indicators.note: to take on means the girl adds the next piece after her name

parts.note: Molly is a girl's name
coddling is cooking an egg gently in water just below boiling

explanation.surface: A girl being spoilt by being given only the easiest kitchen tasks.
explanation.definitionFit: To mollycoddle is to treat someone with excessive indulgence, overprotecting them.

clue.text: It followed the earthquake in eastern rock shaft!

definitions.text: It followed the earthquake in eastern rock shaft!

indicators.note: an earthquake shakes things up, so the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A report of a tremor that came after a quake in a mine shaft in the east.
explanation.walkthrough: 'earthquake' signals an anagram of E (eastern) with ROCK SHAFT, while the whole clue also describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A tremor that comes after a main quake is the classic secondary shock.

clue.text: Extraordinary deed of a lady who makes moves to lessen the resistance

definitions.text: makes moves to lessen the resistance

parts.note: a feat is a remarkable achievement
hers means belonging to a lady

explanation.surface: Praise for a woman's remarkable achievement in reducing opposition.
explanation.walkthrough: In rowing, to feather is to turn the oar blade flat between strokes so it meets less air resistance.
explanation.definitionFit: A rower turns the blade horizontal on the recovery so it cuts through air and water with less drag.

clue.text: Was Tagore perhaps a Nicaraguan politician?

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the poet's name could be rearranged into another

explanation.surface: Asking whether the Indian poet Tagore was a Central American politician.
explanation.definitionFit: Daniel Ortega is a Sandinista leader who has served as president of Nicaragua.

clue.text: An odd couple with directions on how to be surrounded by luxury

indicators.note: being surrounded means the compass points sit within the rearranged letters
odd suggests the letters of couple are put in a strange order

parts.note: E and N are the compass directions east and north

explanation.surface: Advice on how a strange pair might live surrounded by lavish comfort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'odd' gives OPULCE; 'An odd couple' reads as a mismatched pair of people, but only the word couple is shuffled, and the compass points sit inside the result.
explanation.definitionFit: Opulence is great wealth and lavish comfort.

clue.text: Borne up by first evening dress

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top
first takes the opening letter of evening

explanation.surface: Being carried along by the first evening outfit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns BORNE into ENROB; 'first' gives E from evening.
explanation.definitionFit: To enrobe is to clothe someone in a robe or gown.

clue.text: Ancient Egyptian who tossed seamers

indicators.note: tossed means the letters are thrown about and rearranged

explanation.surface: A pharaoh pictured bowling seam deliveries, as in cricket.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, seamers are bowlers who make the ball deviate off its stitched seam.
explanation.definitionFit: Rameses (Ramses) was the name of several pharaohs of ancient Egypt.

clue.text: Get very close to a very quiet fish

parts.note: pp, pianissimo, is the musical mark for very quiet
a roach is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: An angler creeps up silently on a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: To approach is to draw near something.

clue.text: Stance taken by CIA when returning like a fabled Greek

indicators.note: returning means the whole assembled run is read backwards
taken by means the stance word is held inside the agency's letters

parts.note: a pose is a stance

explanation.surface: An agency adopts a position and returns in the manner of an ancient storyteller.
explanation.walkthrough: Holding the stance word inside the agency's initials makes CIPOSEA, which 'when returning' turns round; the agency here is the American Central Intelligence Agency.
explanation.definitionFit: Aesop was the Greek teller of fables, so the adjective means in the style of his fables.

clue.text: A group of walkers who don't know where they are going

definitions.text: A group of walkers who don't know where they are going

parts.words: A group of walkers who don't know where they are going
parts.note: the walkers are lost not on a hike but because they are asleep while moving about

explanation.surface: A hiking party that has lost its way.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleepwalkers move about unconscious, with no awareness of their destination.

clue.text: First baby really unwell-it could be the fish!

indicators.note: first takes the opening letters of the next two words

parts.note: ill means unwell

explanation.surface: A baby falls sick and the suspected cause is fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'First' applies to both baby and really, giving B and R.
explanation.definitionFit: Brill is a flatfish related to the turbot.

clue.text: Test of the mouth

explanation.surface: Read as a dental examination.
explanation.definitionFit: A spoken exam is one sense; the other is the adjective for anything relating to the mouth.

clue.text: Former student took a term in persistent quest

parts.note: OB, old boy, is a former pupil of a school
a session is a term of study or sitting

explanation.surface: An ex-pupil spends a term on a dogged search.
explanation.definitionFit: An obsession is a fixation that keeps driving someone on.

clue.text: Superior sort of shoe covering

explanation.surface: Describing a top-quality piece of footwear.
explanation.definitionFit: Higher in rank is one sense; the other is the part of a shoe above the sole.

clue.text: Collide and embrace

explanation.surface: Two people bumping into each other and hugging.
explanation.definitionFit: In billiards balls that touch lightly are said to do this; it is also touching lips in affection.

clue.text: Unhappy writer, manipulated by the editor

definitions.note: describes a tool the editor wields, so a noun is meant

parts.note: blue means sad
a pencil is a writing implement

explanation.surface: A miserable author pushed around by the editor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'writer' looks like a person but is a writing implement.
explanation.definitionFit: Editors traditionally marked cuts and corrections with a blue-coloured crayon or pencil.
